title: Custom Sign Manufacturing for the Trade
intro: Custom illuminated letters, metal logos and commercial signage, made to your artwork and project specifications.
body:
## Signs for Your Next Customer Project.

We make custom illuminated letters, metal lettering, acrylic logos and commercial signs around your artwork, dimensions and installation requirements.

## From Artwork to an Agreed Specification

Share your drawings, overall dimensions, quantities and destination. We review materials, finish, lighting, mounting and delivery before production approval. Preliminary files are welcome.

## Production and Order Checks

We confirm the appearance, construction, lighting and packing check points for your order. Required inspection records, documentation and installation aids are included where agreed in your quotation.

## Project and Repeat Orders

For repeat or multi-site requirements, identify the approved design reference, quantities by location and any differences in size or fixing. We review schedules, labelling and shipment arrangements for the project.

## Start Your Trade Enquiry

Share your artwork, approximate dimensions, quantity, delivery destination and target date without signing in. We will follow up to clarify the details and prepare your project quote.

faq: Can I start with a preliminary drawing?
Yes. Upload a logo, sketch or reference image and mark any dimensions that are still provisional. We will clarify the open points before production approval.

PDF, AI, EPS, DWG, DXF, JPG, PNG and WebP are supported. Vector artwork is useful for lettering and logos. The enquiry form accepts up to 3 files, 10 MB each and 20 MB in total; export other formats such as CDR as PDF.
Can I request one sign or a repeat order?
Tell us the quantity and whether this is a one-off, repeat or multi-site requirement. We review the construction, order size and schedule individually when preparing your quote.
Can I request samples or a finish reference?
Include the finish, colour or lighting detail you need to review. We will confirm the available sample or approval options, cost and timing for your project.
Can you provide neutral packaging or installation templates?

Tell us what your project needs. Neutral packaging, labels, mounting templates, fixing details and shipment grouping can be discussed before quoting. The items and services included are confirmed in the order scope.
How are production time and shipping confirmed?
Share your destination and any fixed opening or installation date. We confirm production and transit arrangements with your quotation; these are separate parts of the schedule.
Local site work and electrical connection are included only where expressly agreed. Tell us who will install the signs so we can review fixing details and any required installation information.
Can you supply required certificates or inspection records?
Identify the destination, product requirements and documents you need at the enquiry stage. Availability and applicability are confirmed for the quoted configuration before order acceptance.

about.title: Custom Signs, Made Around Your Brand
about.intro: Custom Sign Forge supplies custom illuminated letters, metal logos and commercial signage made to your artwork, space and project requirements.
about.body:
## Made Around Your Brand.

We turn logos, lettering and reference ideas into custom signs for shops, offices, hospitality spaces and commercial projects. Our focus is a clear specification, considered construction and a finished sign that fits its setting.

## From Your Artwork to Production

We review your logo, dimensions, material, finish, lighting and mounting requirements with you. The quotation identifies the supplied items, price and delivery arrangements. Final drawings and open details are confirmed before production begins.

## The Details Behind the Sign

Explore metal construction, illuminated lettering and fabrication details. We review the appearance, order checks and packing requirements against the approved specification. Any requested inspection records, finish references or installation aids are confirmed for the order.

## For Business Owners and the Trade

We welcome individual business projects, sign companies, installers and design teams. Share your intended use, quantity and destination so we can review the right fabrication approach for your project.

## Start with What You Know

A logo, a reference photo or approximate dimensions are enough to begin the conversation. Send your full project details and optional files without creating an account, then discuss the specification and quote with us.
